purpose: Bounty Hunter character select phase - the ten statues, their exact placement and identity.
how_obtained: Actors 0x02121E4C..0x021236A0, stride 0x2B4, read from a dense melonDS capture (out/work/replay_scripts/select.bat, EVERY=3) during the select phase, which is identified on the MAIN engine by DISPCNT 0x00010158 - BG0 only, no 2D layer. Transform is the 4x3 20.12 matrix at actor+0x8C. Identity is the statue asset id held at actor+0xE8 AND +0x230; all ten hunters appear exactly once across the ten actors, which is what makes the mapping trustworthy rather than assumed.
layout: A ring at y=6, TWELVE positions 30 degrees apart with TEN occupied - the two empty ones fall between Dengar and IG-88 (58.77 deg) and between Jango and Greedo (60.45 deg). Eight gaps of ~30 plus two of ~60 sum to 360 exactly. An earlier note claimed a single wide gap and named only the Dengar/IG-88 one; there are two, so this is a 12-slot ring rather than a 10-slot one. RADIUS IS NOT CONSTANT either: it runs 58.00 (Leia) to 60.03 (Lando, Jango), a spread of 2.03 units, so '~59' is a centre rather than a value. Each statue faces the centre, but yaw is NOT simply -ring_angle: the deviation splits into two clusters, ~0.35-0.44 deg for slots 1/3/8/9 and ~4.6-5.15 deg for slots 0/2/4/5/6/7, which is too large and too structured to be fixed-point rounding. The captured yaw is applied directly rather than recomputed.
order_note: The ring order is NOT roster order. Roster order is 4-LOM, Boba, Bossk, Dengar, Greedo, IG-88, Jango, Lando, Leia, Zuckuss; the ring runs Greedo, 4-LOM, Boba, Bossk, Dengar, [gap], IG-88, Lando, Leia, Zuckuss, Jango. Assuming roster order would have placed seven of ten wrongly.
countdown: NOT located. A first scan found 0x02101DE8 counting down at an apparent 1/second, but a dense re-read showed a 15->0 sawtooth every ~32 frames that sparse sampling had aliased into a ramp. A dense monotonic scan over the phase produced no true per-second counter in main RAM. The sub engine holds DISPCNT 0x00011f50 (BG+OBJ) throughout the phase while the main engine has no 2D layer at all, so the countdown is drawn on the TOUCH screen and should be looked for in sub OAM/BG next.
